image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf on a serving platter. The loaf has a browned, textured exterior with a glossy, dark red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato-based) pooled in crevices and on top. Several slices have been cut, revealing a dense, coarse interior texture with visible flecks of ingredients. The lighting is warm, highlighting the moisture and grease on the surface.

The bottom-most slice on the right seems to merge slightly with the platter/foil beneath it. The boundary is not perfectly crisp, and the geometry of the slice's corner appears slightly melted or undefined compared to the rigid structure expected of a cooled meatloaf slice.
